evals.prompt: The approved 30-second coast clip has unwanted speech in its native audio. Write an ambience-only replacement bed; keep the picture unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A positive layer-based bed prompt with rough event timing, explicit exclusions, and a verification and assembly handoff.
assertions: Preserves the approved picture and proposes replacing its soundtrack rather than regenerating the video.
Uses surf, wind and gulls as positive acoustic layers and treats no-voices/no-music wording as a request to verify.
States that generated event timestamps are approximate and a visible-action effect needs separate placement for exact sync.
Does not invent dialogue, mandate a production application or save files without a request.

evals.prompt: Plan a silent-picture scene with a separate score only: low cello, a rising pulse, then a quiet ending. Do not generate anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A picture-only option conditional on destination support and a standalone score prompt with no dialogue requirement.
assertions: Uses picture-only generation only if the selected destination supports disabling native audio, otherwise proposes replacing or muting the native soundtrack in post.
Specifies score instrumentation and arc without inventing speech or environmental effects.
Does not submit, require a review gate or assume an API field is universally available.

evals.prompt: Write a very short spoken line and make it stop exactly at 3.000 seconds. The ASR says one word is missing and says the accent is correct.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the exact supplied line, leave trailing space, measure actual timing, and distinguish transcript evidence from listening.
assertions: Requests about a second of trailing silence and checks that the last word is complete.
Does not guarantee exact generated timing; proposes measured trimming or padding when needed.
Checks the audio before treating the ASR result as a confirmed omission.
Requires a native listener for accent and pronunciation rather than accepting an ASR claim.
